subject: Operations / Performance

findings.subject: Operations / Performance
findings.title: Synchronous connection Open, BeginTransaction, Commit and Rollback inside an async request path

evidence.excerpt: var connection = CreateConnection(...); if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open) { connection.Open(); } var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();

findings.recommendation: Type the connection as DbConnection and use OpenAsync(cancellationToken), BeginTransactionAsync, CommitAsync and RollbackAsync so the ASP.NET Core request thread isn't blocked on network I/O.

findings.subject: Operations / Performance
findings.title: Pooled DB connection isn't released if Open/BeginTransaction fails; connection and transaction never disposed

evidence.excerpt: var connection = CreateConnection(...); ... connection.Open(); ... var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();  (outside the try/finally)

findings.recommendation: Wrap the connection and transaction in 'await using' declarations immediately after creation so the connection returns to the pool on every path.
